routes.title: Accountable AI and Aureon OS programmes
routes.status_detail: Public-sector R&D provides a disciplined route for testing Aureon's evidence-control core across accountable AI, connectivity, creative workflows and energy-system assurance.

routes.public_signal: The public architecture, research method and sector theses support a credible R&D proposition.
routes.next_gate: Independent assessment, a bounded implementation and a measured outcome
routes.public_boundary: Strategic relevance is not an award, customer contract, product validation or programme endorsement.

routes.public_signal: The public code and evidence architecture establish the basis for a compute-scale evaluation proposition.

routes.public_boundary: Strategic fit is not compute allocation, cash funding, performance validation or commercial deployment.
